cards.name: Zone Eater
cards.officialTextJa: 「ゾーン・イーター」の攻撃を受けたモンスターは、５ターン後に破壊される。
cards.officialRuling: The attack turn is turn 1; count both players' turns; destroy during the End Phase of turn 5; no chain block is created by the destruction processing.

cards.name: Swordsman from a Distant Land
cards.officialTextJa: 「異国の剣士」の攻撃を受けたモンスターは、５ターン後に破壊される。
cards.officialRuling: The attack turn is turn 1; count both players' turns; destroy during the End Phase of turn 5; no chain block is created by the destruction processing.

sharedRuling.destructionWindow: End Phase of the fifth turn

implementationNotes: The event is captured after damage calculation from the attack snapshot; the source monster does not need to remain on the field.
The attacked monster is tracked by physical UID and epoch. Leaving and re-entering the field creates a different instance and prevents stale destruction.
Control may change before the due End Phase; if the same physical card remains in the Monster Zone, it is still destroyed.
The destination Graveyard follows the physical owner's team, not the controller at resolution.
scope: Isolated delayed battle-destruction primitive, tests, official evidence and focused workflow only. No card registry, catalog, certification, Discord handler or persistent duel-state integration.
certificationGate: Do not certify until integrated into the live battle/End Phase resolver and validated in complete 2v2 matches.
